remarks: HIGHEST & BEST BY 12 PM ON TUESDAY, 7/1. Fall in love with this storybook cape on a beautiful corner lot in Brookside - close to schools, SONO, shopping and restaurants, I-95, Metro-North, beaches, and Rowayton. This charming 2 Bedroom 1 Bath home is move-in ready and can be embraced as-is, or take advantage of the full lower and upper levels for expansion. The first floor open living & dining room combo with wood-burning fireplace, built-in buffet and hw floors creates a cozy atmoshpere. Eat-in-Kitchen provides ample space for cooking. 2 large bedrooms with hw floors and a full bath complete the main level. Downstairs, a family room and unfinished basement with laundry area provide storage and more expansion potential. A high-ceilinged walk-up attic already plumbed for a bathroom is just waiting for your final touches - large primary suite, additional bedrooms, home office, studio; or just keep it as is for storage. Attached one car garage also offers plenty of storage and work space. Mature perennial gardens will delight you with blooms all season long. Stone patio is perfect for al-fresco dining and enjoying warm summer nights in a private setting. The large yard hidden from the street by trees is perfect for family time and entertaining. This is an estate, no disclosures. Located in C-zone, please do your research re: additional expansion options.
